record.paper_title: Topological Open Problems in the Geometry of Banach Spaces
record.context_brief: Pointwise Borel structure and LUR renorming for Baire-one compacta
record.original_question: Let Γ be a Polish space and let K⊂R^Γ be a compact set of Baire-one functions such that every function in K has at most countably many discontinuities. For C(K), do the Borel sets generated by the pointwise topology and by the supremum norm topology coincide? Is the identity map from C(K) with the pointwise topology to C(K) with the supremum norm σ-continuous? Does C(K) admit an equivalent locally uniformly rotund norm?

evidence.quote: Question 9. Let K ⊂ RΓ be a compact subset of Baire one functions on a Polish space Γ such that every function of K has at most countably many discontinuities. Do the Borel sets for the pointwise and the norm topologies coincide in C(K)? Is the identity map Id : Cp(K) → (C(K), k · k∞) σ-continuous? Does the Banach space C(K) admit an equivalent LUR norm?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let Γ be a Polish space, and let K ⊂ ℝ^Γ be a pointwise compact set of Baire-one functions on Γ such that every function f ∈ K has at most countably many points of discontinuity. Let C(K) denote the Banach space of continuous real-valued functions on K endowed with the supremum norm ‖·‖_∞, and let C_p(K) denote the same vector space endowed with the topology of pointwise convergence on K. Answer the following three questions:

(a) Do the σ-algebras of Borel subsets of C(K) generated by the pointwise topology and by the norm topology coincide?

(b) Is the identity map Id : C_p(K) → (C(K), ‖·‖_∞) σ-continuous, i.e., can C(K) be written as a countable union of sets on each of which the identity is continuous from the pointwise to the norm topology?

(c) Does C(K) admit an equivalent locally uniformly rotund (LUR) norm? (A norm ‖·‖ is LUR if, whenever x_n, x ∈ C(K) satisfy 2‖x‖² + 2‖x_n‖² − ‖x + x_n‖² → 0, then ‖x_n − x‖ → 0.)
artifact.category_tag: Renormings of C(K) and Baire-one compacta
artifact.status_search_result: Haydon, Moltó and Orihuela (Israel J. Math. 158 (2007), 19–39, "Spaces of functions with countably many discontinuities") proved that when K is additionally separable (as a pointwise compact set of functions on a Polish space Γ with each function having countably many discontinuities), C(K) admits an equivalent LUR norm, the two Borel structures agree, and the identity from C_p(K) to (C(K),‖·‖_∞) is σ-continuous. The general (non-separable) case appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Spaces of functions with countably many discontinuities — Israel J. Math.
status_evidence.snippet: For Γ Polish and K a separable pointwise compact set of functions on Γ each with only countably many discontinuities, C(K) admits an equivalent LUR norm.
status_evidence.claim: Resolves the LUR renorming question affirmatively under the additional hypothesis that K is separable.

status_evidence.title: On some problems concerning Borel structures in function spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies coincidence of pointwise and norm Borel σ-algebras and σ-continuity of the identity in C(K) for related classes.
status_evidence.claim: Related affirmative results in the separable case for the Borel-structure and σ-continuity questions.
